name: Disneyland Jolly Holiday Matterhorn Coconut Macaron (Fiber Warning) vs. Mickey Shortbread Cookie
brandOrRestaurant: Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: While the Matterhorn Macaron is gluten-friendly, it is packed with dense shredded coconut (which is pure insoluble fiber that does not dissolve in the gut)—swap for a smooth Mickey Butter Shortbread or Sugar Cookie instead.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip the shredded-coconut Matterhorn Macaron and raspberry-seeded Rose Gold macarons during sensitive days; order a plain Mickey Shortbread Cookie or Chocolate Chip Cookie instead.
watchOuts: Shredded coconut in the Matterhorn Macaron is a deceptive insoluble-fiber trigger for Crohn's
